items.raw_quote: `GET /api/notes?q=<text>`.
items.our_interpretation: The existing GET /api/notes accepts an optional q parameter; no new endpoint is added.

items.raw_quote: Without `q` — all notes of the current user.
items.our_interpretation: A request without q returns all notes of the authenticated user through the existing owner-scoped list path.

items.raw_quote: With `q` — case-insensitive search over note text.
items.our_interpretation: A non-empty q is matched case-insensitively as a substring of note text using strings.ToLower on both sides; no locale-specific collation is promised. This is the s05 B-3 reading of the item.

items.raw_quote: Only notes of the current user are returned.
items.our_interpretation: The owner predicate is applied first via ListNotes(session.UserID); q can only narrow, never widen, the current user's result set.

items.raw_quote: Without bearer token — HTTP 401.
items.our_interpretation: A missing, invalid or expired bearer token returns 401 with WWW-Authenticate: Bearer before method or query handling.

items.raw_quote: Empty `q` — all notes.
items.our_interpretation: q= (empty) returns all notes of the current user with 200, never 400.

items.raw_quote: Whitespace-only `q` — must be fixed in the spec as either all notes or 400.
items.our_interpretation: The item explicitly allows either option; we choose 'all notes'. Whitespace-only q is trimmed, treated as empty, and returns all notes of the current user (OD-1/B-2), covered by TestNotesSearchWhitespaceQuery.

items.raw_quote: Tests: search finds a note.
items.our_interpretation: TestNotesSearchFinds proves that a matching query returns the note.

items.raw_quote: Tests: search does not find an absent note.
items.our_interpretation: TestNotesSearchNotFound proves that a non-matching query returns 200 with [] and no error.

items.raw_quote: Tests: a user does not see another user's notes.
items.our_interpretation: TestNotesSearchIsolation proves in both directions that user B cannot see user A's notes in search results.

items.raw_quote: Tests: unauthenticated request returns 401.
items.our_interpretation: TestNotesSearchAuthRequired (with TestAuthRequired) proves that an unauthenticated search request returns 401.

items.raw_quote: Tests: URL-encoding and special characters in `q`.
items.our_interpretation: TestNotesSearchEncoding proves that URL-encoded and special characters (%20, +, %2B, & and other special characters) decode via r.URL.Query().Get and do not panic or return 500.
